findings.detail: Supplemental currency-detail rows in table 38 were counted as additional holdings; their FMV values sum to 77.860 million, exactly the overshoot over the 1,488.856 million investment anchor.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing and companyfacts investment anchor at 1,488,856 thousand (table 12 row 4 and table 37 row 4), while the extracted position sum is 1,566,716 thousand. The 77,860 thousand residual equals the sum of table 38 FMV rows 2-9: 23,122 + 31,543 + 743 - 37 + 15,940 - 123 + 6,286 + 386. Table 38 is a supplemental Issuer/Investment Type/Currency/Cost/FMV presentation, and the same issuers appear in the main schedule, so counting these rows as independent positions creates a duplicate/dimension double count.
